catalog.title: Positive tone
catalog.description: Add a direction fitted from positive versus negative review contexts.
catalog.default_prompt: My experience at the cafe was
catalog.interpretation_limit: A contrast-trained residual direction and hand-written lexical probes; not a complete concept, a causal circuit, or a safety guarantee. Discovery cases guide search; confirmation cases audit chosen candidates.

evidence.scope: Curated synthetic positive-tone experiment. Recorded CPU measurements; public exhibit performs no inference. Lexical scores are task-specific proxies. Attention and structural paths do not establish a complete causal circuit.
